title: Z-Image Turbo diffusion model (S3-DiT, 30 layers, Qwen 3 4B captions)

provenance.source: safetensors header of diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors (12309866400 bytes, Comfy-Org/Z-Image-Turbo) on the reference target (ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0 on port 8188, GAPS Q17)
provenance.note: 453 tensors under cap_embedder, x_embedder, t_embedder, noise_refiner (2 blocks), context_refiner (2 blocks), layers (0 to 29) and final_layer; cap_embedder.1.weight is [3840, 2560], the 2560-wide Qwen 3 4B hidden state projected to 3840. No tensor is prefixed. The header doesn't tell Turbo from Z-Image Base, which shares the architecture; FLUX's double_blocks are forbidden so a FLUX file can't match.
